title: the Impact of COVID-19 Pandemic on the Incidence and Outcome of Complicated Appendicitis
brief_summary: During the COVID-19 pandemic, we noticed a rise in complicated appendicitis cases presenting to our medical center. We collected objective data on all patients admitted to the surgical department with appendicitis during February 2020 - March 2020 compared to the same 2 month period in 2019, to understand the pandemic's affect on the rate of complications of acute appendicitis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* appendicitis

Exclusion Criteria:

* any other diagnosis
study_population: all patients who underwent appendectomy in meir medical center, during the study period
